title: Obstructive Uropathy & Renal Hydrodynamics Masterclass
description: 整合尿路阻塞 (Obstructive Uropathy) 之急慢性血流動力學、管泡反流、小管濃縮功能障礙與 Post-Obstructive Diuresis 之專科課程。

sections.title: Module 1: Acute vs Chronic Renal Biphasic Hemodynamics & Intratubular Hydrodynamics
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Hemodynamic Mapping Matrix

| Phase of Obstruction | Time Frame | Renal Blood Flow (RBF) | Ureteral / Intratubular Pressure | Dominant Vasoactive Mediator |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Phase I (Early Acute) | 0–1.5 Hours | Increased (Hyperemia) | Markedly Increased | Prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) & Nitric Oxide (NO) Vasodilation of Afferent Arteriole |
| Phase II (Late Acute) | 1.5–5 Hours | Decreased | Sustained High Pressure | Thromboxane A2 (TxA2) & Angiotensin II (Ang II) Constriction of Afferent Arteriole |
| Phase III (Chronic) | > 24 Hours / Days | Markedly Decreased (Ischemia) | Normal to Low-Normal | Tubulointerstitial Fibrosis & Persistent Efferent/Afferent Vasoconstriction |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Parameter | Early Acute Bilateral Obstruction | Chronic Bilateral Obstruction | Acute Tubular Necrosis (ATN) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Fractional Excretion of Sodium (FENa) | Low (< 1%) initially (Pre-renal pattern) | High (> 2% - Tubule Unresponsiveness) | High (> 2%) |
| Urinary Osmolality | Elevated (> 500 mOsm/kg) | Isosthenuric (250–350 mOsm/kg) | Isosthenuric |
| Urinary Concentrating Ability | Preserved | Severely Impaired (Acquired Nephrogenic DI) | Severely Impaired |
| Renal Pelvis Pressure | Markedly High | Moderately High to Normal (Atrophy) | Low / Normal |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Acute Urinary Tract Obstruction ➔ Intratubular Hydraulic Pressure Increases ➔ Retrograde Pressure Transmitted to Bowman Space ➔ Decreased Transcapillary Hydrostatic Pressure Gradient (ΔP) ➔ Abrupt Dip in GFR ➔ PGE2 Synthesis Relaxes Afferent Arteriole (Transient RBF Rise) ➔ TxA2 & Ang II Synthesis Constricts Afferent Arteriole ➔ Sustained RBF Reduction & Ischemic Tubular Injury.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為急性尿路阻塞時，腎血流 (RBF) 會隨著管腔內壓力上升而同步即刻下降。
**Analysis**: 急性阻塞前 1.5 小時內，腎血流反而呈暫時性上升 (Phase I Hyperemia)。這是由於高管腔壓力刺激腎臟局部合成 PGE2 與 NO，擴張入球小動脈 (Afferent Arteriole) 所致。直至 1.5 小時後，TxA2 與 Ang II 的強烈收縮作用佔上風，RBF 才轉為進行性下降 (Phase II)。

sections.title: Module 2: Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD) & Electrolyte Wasting Pathophysiology
sections.content:
### 1. Dynamic Transport Mechanism Matrix

| Nephron Segment | Transporter / Water Channel Affected | Functional Defect in Post-Obstructive Diuresis | Clinical Sequelae |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Medullary Collecting Duct | Aquaporin-2 (AQP2) Downregulation | Unresponsiveness to Vasopressin (AVP) | Polyuria & Acquired Nephrogenic Diabetes Insipidus |
| Thick Ascending Limb (TALH) | NKCC2 (Na-K-2Cl Cotransporter) Suppression | Loss of Countercurrent Multiplication & Medullary Hypertonicity | Severe Natriuresis & Impaired Diluting Capacity |
| Proximal Convoluted Tubule | Na+/H+ Exchanger 3 (NHE3) & Na-K-ATPase Reduction | Decreased Bicarbonate & Solute Reabsorption | Solute Diuresis & Bicarbonate Wasting |

### 2. High-Yield Differential Comparison Table

| Parameter | Physiological Solute-Driven POD | Pathological Tubular Injury POD | Fluid Overload Clearance Diuresis |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Primary Mechanism | Excretion of Accumulated Urea & Sodium | Downregulation of AQP2 & NKCC2 | Elimination of Pre-existing Intravascular Fluid |
| Duration | Self-Limiting (24–48 Hours) | Prolonged (> 48 Hours) | Self-Limiting upon Euvolemia |
| Hemodynamic Status | Stable | Risk of Severe Hypovolemia & Shock | Hypervolemic ➔ Euvolemic |
| Replacement Therapy | Replace 50–75% of Hourly Urine Volume | Replace 50-75% + Electrolyte Titration | No Fluid Replacement Needed |

### 3. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Relief of Bilateral Obstruction ➔ Sudden Excretion of Accumulated Retained Urea & Solutes ➔ Solute Osmotic Diuresis + Persistent Downregulation of AQP2 & NKCC2 ➔ Profuse Post-Obstructive Diuresis (> 200 mL/hr) ➔ Risk of Volume Depletion, Hypokalemia, & Severe Hypernatremia ➔ Monitor Hourly Urine Output & Replace 50-75% of Volume with 0.45% Saline.

### 4. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 對所有 Post-Obstructive Diuresis (POD) 患者進行 100% 等量尿量液體補充 (1:1 Fluid Replacement)。
**Analysis**: 盲目 1:1 補充尿量會持續補給溶質與水份，反而人為延續 (Perpetuate) Diuresis。正確處置為給予 50%–75% 的前一小時尿量補充（首選 0.45% Saline），既能維護血管內容積安全，又能讓體內累積的 Urea 與鈉鹽順利廓清並終止 POD。

sections.title: Module 3: Tubulointerstitial Fibrosis & Obstructive Nephropathy Progression
sections.content:
### 1. Molecular & Cellular Mediator Matrix

| Cytokine / Growth Factor | Cellular Source | Pathological Function in Obstructive Nephropathy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| TGF-beta1 | Injured Tubular Epithelium & Macrophages | Primary Driver of Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (EMT) & Extracellular Matrix (ECM) Synthesis |
| Monocyte Chemoattractant Protein-1 (MCP-1) | Tubular Epithelium under Mechanical Stretch | Recruitment of Inflammatory Macrophages to Tubulointerstitium |
| Angiotensin II | Local Intrarenal RAS Activation | Vasoconstriction, NF-kB Activation, Pro-inflammatory & Fibrotic Signaling |

### 2. Pathophysiological Decision Tree

Sustained Ureteral Obstruction ➔ Hydrostatic Stretch of Tubular Epithelial Cells ➔ Upregulation of MCP-1 & Angiotensin II ➔ Macrophage Infiltration & TGF-beta1 Secretion ➔ Fibroblast Proliferation & Transdifferentiation into Myofibroblasts ➔ Accumulation of Collagen Type I & III in Interstitium ➔ Permanent Tubulointerstitial Atrophy & Irreversible Loss of Renal Function.

### 3. Conceptual Trap Analysis

**Trap**: 認為解除阻塞後，即使腎功能未完全恢復，腎臟的組織纖維化程序也會自動完全停止。
**Analysis**: 即使解除物理性阻塞，早期由 TGF-beta1 與 Ang II 啟動的發炎及纖維化瀑布反應仍可能在間質持續蔓延。因此早期及時解除阻塞 (Unroofing / Decompression) 對於保護剩餘腎元數量至關重要。
